# QA Report — BSI Authentication login and recovery pilot

## Run information

- Run ID: `QABSI-LOGIN-STATIC-20261112`
- Module: authentication
- Environment: development
- Target: Not recorded
- Repository: bsi-auth-web-example
- Commit: `347be7947277be6005f5a721e7ec1109e29a9a1e`
- Merge request: Not recorded
- Started: 2026-11-12T00:00:00+07:00
- Finished: Not finished

## Summary

| Total | Pass | Fail | Blocked | Skipped | Not run | Flaky | Environment error |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 34 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 34 | 0 | 0 |

## Test cases

| ID | Requirements | Layer | Scenario | Expected | Actual | Status | Severity | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-LOGIN-001 | FR-AUTH-001 | component | Login alias redirects to the canonical login route | The router resolves to /account/login and renders LoginComponent without a redirect loop. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-LOGIN-002 | FR-AUTH-002 | component | Empty username and password cannot be submitted | Submit remains disabled and required-field feedback is visible for both fields. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-LOGIN-003 | FR-AUTH-002 | component | Only username populated remains invalid | The form stays invalid and no authentication request is sent. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-LOGIN-004 | FR-AUTH-003 | e2e | Valid credentials navigate to the approved redirect URL | One login request succeeds and the user reaches the approved redirect route. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-LOGIN-005 | FR-AUTH-004 | security | Unknown username and wrong password produce equivalent safe failures | Failures do not disclose whether an account exists and do not expose internal details. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-LOGIN-006 | FR-AUTH-003 | component | Repeated submit while loading initiates one request | The button remains disabled while loading and only one service call is initiated. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-LOGIN-007 | FR-AUTH-005 | component | Production hides direct login controls by default | Direct-login controls are hidden while approved SSO entry points remain available. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-LOGIN-008 | FR-AUTH-005 | security | Developer query override follows approved production policy | Behavior matches an explicitly approved policy and cannot bypass server-side authentication controls. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-SSO-001 | FR-SSO-001 | component | Member and parent SSO links use environment configuration | Both links are present and match the approved destinations for the environment. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-SSO-002 | FR-SSO-002 | e2e | Valid SSO callback authenticates and redirects | The callback is accepted once and the user reaches the approved redirect route. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-SSO-003 | FR-SSO-002 | e2e | Invalid or expired SSO callback is rejected safely | Authentication is rejected, no session is established, and a safe error is displayed. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-SSO-004 | FR-SSO-003 | component | Opening login without a query token invokes logout once | Logout is called once and no SSO login call is made. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-SSO-005 | FR-SSO-002 | security | Authentication secrets do not leak through browser surfaces | No reusable secret is retained or disclosed beyond the approved exchange boundary. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-SSO-006 | FR-SSO-002 | component | Malformed SSO callback path fails without unsafe navigation | Malformed paths are rejected predictably without logging secrets or navigating to an unintended route. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-MFA-001 | FR-MFA-001 | component | 2FA-enabled primary login shows the authenticator form | Direct navigation does not occur and the required authenticator form is displayed. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-MFA-002 | FR-MFA-002 | component | Empty authenticator code cannot be submitted | The form remains invalid and verify2FA is not called. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-MFA-003 | FR-MFA-002 | e2e | Valid authenticator code completes login | Verification succeeds once and navigation reaches the approved redirect route. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-MFA-004 | FR-MFA-002 | api | Wrong, expired, reused, and cross-account codes are rejected | Every invalid class is rejected and no full session is issued. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-MFA-005 | FR-MFA-001, FR-MFA-002 | security | Post-login resources cannot be accessed before second-factor verification | Pre-MFA state cannot access resources requiring full authentication. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-MFA-006 | FR-MFA-002 | security | Repeated invalid codes are throttled according to contract | Attempts are bounded without uncontrolled account denial-of-service and recovery follows policy. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-001 | FR-REC-001 | component | Forgot-password action switches from login to recovery | Login/2FA forms are replaced by the account-recovery entry state with no retained credential values. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-REC-002 | FR-REC-001 | contract | Account verification request matches the approved API contract | The request, status, response envelope, and error behavior conform to the approved contract. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-003 | FR-REC-001 | security | Known and unknown accounts receive enumeration-safe recovery responses | Responses do not disclose account existence beyond approved policy. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-004 | FR-REC-001 | e2e | Verified test account receives one sandbox OTP request | One request is recorded, loading settles, and the OTP entry state is enabled without exposing the code. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-005 | FR-REC-002 | api | Valid OTP advances once and returns a scoped reset token | The flow advances once, a scoped token is returned securely, and reuse is rejected. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-006 | FR-REC-002 | api | Wrong, expired, reused, and cross-account recovery codes are rejected | Every invalid class is rejected without issuing a reset token or leaking account data. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-007 | FR-REC-003 | component | Mismatched password confirmation is prevented or rejected clearly | The mismatch is blocked with specific feedback and no password change occurs. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-REC-008 | FR-REC-003 | contract | Password policy boundaries are enforced consistently by UI and API | UI and API consistently enforce the approved policy without exposing password values. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-009 | FR-REC-003 | security | Reset token is account-bound, short-lived, single-use, and invalid after success | Only the valid first use succeeds; all other classes are rejected without account change. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-REC-010 | FR-REC-003 | security | Successful reset follows the approved session and token invalidation policy | Old sessions/tokens are invalidated according to the approved recovery policy. |  | not_run | — | auth-platform |
| TC-STATE-001 | FR-STATE-001 | component | Back action clears local recovery secrets and flags | Recovery identifiers, OTP, token, passwords, errors, loading, and visibility return to the initial login state. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-A11Y-001 | — | accessibility | All login, SSO, 2FA, recovery, and back actions are keyboard operable | Interactive elements are reachable in logical order, visibly focused, and operable without a pointer. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-A11Y-002 | — | accessibility | Inputs have programmatic names and errors are associated with fields | Every control has an unambiguous programmatic name and each error is perceivable and associated with its field. |  | not_run | — | frontend |
| TC-A11Y-003 | — | accessibility | Loading, errors, success, and step transitions are announced | Dynamic states are perceivable without relying only on color or visual position, and focus moves predictably. |  | not_run | — | frontend |

## Access-control matrix

No access-control matrix was recorded for this run.

## Security and access-control findings

No normalized security finding was recorded for this run.

## Limitations

- Planning-only pilot: no test case was executed and every status is not_run.
- No target URL, authorized account, OTP sandbox, or runtime contract was provided.
- AuthenticationService is supplied by external package @bsi/auth-core 4.1.3 and was not source-reviewed.
- The referenced login APIs are not implemented in the supplied bsi-auth-api-example repository.
- Both application worktrees contain unrelated local changes; analyzed login files were not modified.

## Publication state

This artifact is a sanitized draft. Publishing and assignment require explicit authorization.
